date.as_written: śāke 1724 samvat 1859 vaiśākhamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyāṃ tithau maṃgalavāsareasya samāptiriti(śatabhiṣaṃti)

notes: The catalogue records the scribe as Viṣṇudāsa, but this name does not appear in the transcribed colophon text. The colophon mentions both Śaka 1724 and Vikrama Saṃvat 1859.
